attributes.board_name: Wisconsin Occupational Therapists Affiliated Credentialing Board (DSPS)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 12 points from 2 or more Table OT 3.06 activities related to OT; the rest from education related to the licensee's practice. Table: academic courses 4 points per credit; WOTA/AOTA/NBCOT-approved seminars, workshops, conferences, interactive online/video courses, webinars 1 per contact hour; AOTA self-study 4 per CEU; AOTA CE article with exam 1 each; employer CE 1 per contact hour; AOTA board certification or listed specialty certifications 12; AOTA specialty certification 10; book 12; chapter 6; non-peer article 4; peer-reviewed article 6; media 6; QA study 6; principal research 12; presentations 2 per contact hour; mentoring 1 per 2 hours; Level I fieldwork 2; Level II 8; reimbursement or ethics courses 1 per contact hour.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE between initial licensure and the start of the first full 2-year licensure period.
rules.audit_note: Certify completion at renewal; keep certificates at least 2 years after the biennium. The board audits licensees under investigation for misconduct.
rules.legal_basis: Wis. Admin. Code OT 3.06 (Register July 2025 No. 835); Wis. Stat. §§440.08(2)(a), 448.967
rules.notes: Points per Table OT 3.06; a contact hour is at least 50 minutes of professional activity (1 point per contact hour for most courses). Biennial renewal by the date set in Wis. Stat. §440.08(2)(a).
